last_data_row = 1

            last_data_row = row

    last_data_row = 2

start_part_letter = get_column_letter(start_part_col)
last_part_letter = get_column_letter(last_part_col)
start_qty_letter = get_column_letter(start_part_col + 1)
last_qty_letter = get_column_letter(last_qty_col)

# Formula logic:
# 1. ($O$2:$W$last=$A2) identifies cells in the raw-part-number area matching A2.
# 2. N($P$2:$X$last) supplies the quantity immediately to the right of each checked cell.
#    N() converts text cells in the shifted range to 0, avoiding errors.
# 3. MOD(COLUMN(...)-COLUMN($O$2),2)=0 restricts matches to actual raw-part columns
#    O, Q, S, U, etc., excluding the quantity columns that are also inside the checked area.
# 4. SUMPRODUCT multiplies those arrays and totals the matching quantities.

    f'${start_part_letter}$2:${last_part_letter}${last_data_row}=$A2)'
    f'*N(${start_qty_letter}$2:${last_qty_letter}${last_data_row})'
    f'*(MOD(COLUMN(${start_part_letter}$2:${last_part_letter}${last_data_row})'
    f'-COLUMN(${start_part_letter}$2),2)=0))'
)
